terms.label: Activity
terms.definition: A captured time interval and its minimized context.

terms.label: Timeline
terms.definition: A chronological view of activities.

terms.label: Category
terms.definition: A user-defined classification such as Work or Communication.

terms.label: Project
terms.definition: A user-controlled grouping for reports and timesheets.

terms.label: Rule
terms.definition: Deterministic local classification, exclusion, or automation logic.

terms.label: Privacy Zone
terms.definition: A local condition in which selected capture or sharing is blocked.

terms.label: Privacy Firewall
terms.definition: The mandatory policy layer for every outbound payload.

terms.label: Vault
terms.definition: Encrypted local activity storage.

terms.label: Sync Vault
terms.definition: An end-to-end encrypted dataset shared by paired devices.

terms.label: Device
terms.definition: A paired PeakActivity installation.

terms.label: Insight
terms.definition: A deterministic analysis or optional AI-generated explanation.

terms.label: Report
terms.definition: A user-readable summary that is not shared until approved.

terms.label: Approved Timesheet
terms.definition: A report artifact explicitly approved for a recipient.

terms.label: AI Mode
terms.definition: The selected AI connection state: Off, Peak AI, or Custom Endpoint.

terms.label: Peak AI
terms.definition: PeakActivity-served access to the provider and model selected by PeakActivity.

terms.label: Custom Endpoint
terms.definition: A user-configured endpoint and model, including an external or paired-device service.

terms.label: Receipt
terms.definition: A record of destination, purpose, fields, policy, and approval.

terms.label: Plugin
terms.definition: A signed capability-limited extension.

terms.label: Category weight
terms.definition: A number chosen by the user to tune that user’s own category weighting.

terms.label: Category weighting
terms.definition: A local report computed from category weights chosen by the user.
